items.title: Can late delivery risk be predicted before delivery?
items.detail: Checkout stage ROC-AUC 0.65 (weak); carrier hand-off stage 0.79. Strong temporal shift in late rate.

items.title: Which sellers/months are statistically unusual?
items.detail: Anomaly detectors use FDR-controlled tests; accuracy cannot be scored without labels.

items.title: Do richer NLP features improve review understanding?
items.detail: Rules/TF-IDF measured on 150 labels from one AI annotator. Multilingual transformer NOT RUN (downloads blocked).

items.title: Are multi-agent investigations faithful to the data?
items.detail: Agent vs independent pandas gold on 30 sellers; see Experiment 5.

items.title: Do agents save analyst time?
items.detail: Needs human participants timed on manual vs agent investigation. Protocol: docs/V2_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOLS.md

items.title: Do explanations (SHAP) help users trust/act?
items.detail: SHAP computed in v1; human study not possible here.

items.title: Does grounding reduce LLM hallucination?
items.detail: No local LLM in the build environment. The assistant has a numeric-consistency guard for an optional LLM, tested only with stub functions.

items.title: Explainability (SHAP) evaluation
items.detail: Grouped SHAP importance reported in the v1 report; no human evaluation.

items.title: Recommendation evaluation
items.detail: Recommendations R1-R7 are evidence-linked in v1; no outcome data exists to evaluate whether they help.
